Select the first 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL2959. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL2959, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
